subject: Consolidated admin ops ledger export and delivery options for SOC2/SIG review
messages:
From: Amira Khan <security@stellarhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: Request: consolidated admin ops ledger export and delivery options for SOC2/SIG

Hi Logan —

We're preparing for our SIG and SOC 2 evidence run and need a consolidated admin activity ledger for the last 12 months. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a point-in-time snapshot that includes:
- timestamped admin events (login, logout, MFA failures)
- user identity (internal user id + email) and role at time of event
- privileged actions (role changes, IAM/policy edits, API key/service-account create/delete)
- console and API access events with request IDs and source IPs
- model-serving admin actions (model deploys/rollbacks, quantization/variant changes)
- token/key issuance and revocation events

Also please include:
- default retention policy and whether the last 12 months are available in full fidelity
- export formats (CSV/Parquet/JSON) and compression options
- delivery methods you support (S3 presigned upload, encrypted FTP, signed snapshot via secure transfer)
- options for signed manifests and chain-of-custody attestation

We may need this for procurement and our external auditor — can you provide a short statement on the contents and an estimated delivery timeline?

Thanks,
Amira Khan
Sr. InfoSec Manager — StellarHealth
security@stellarhealth.com

--
Attachment: none (will accept your manifest + sample snapshot)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khan <security@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated admin ops ledger export and delivery options for SOC2/SIG

Amira —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a full-fidelity export for the last 12 months and a few delivery options. Looping in Marissa (security lead) and Vanessa (ops) to confirm exact event types and packaging. High-level plan:

1) Confirm scope & fields (security/ops) — 24 hours
2) Prepare a signed point-in-time snapshot (compressed Parquet or CSV) + sha256 manifest — 3 business days
3) Deliver via secure S3 presigned upload or our encrypted transfer endpoint; we can also generate an SFTP transfer if you require an appliance-based pull — delivery window same-day once snapshot is ready

Questions for you:
- Do auditors require a signed timestamp authority (TSA) on the manifest, or will SHA256 + our signature suffice?
- Would you prefer daily rolling exports (for streaming ingest) in addition to the one-off snapshot?

I'll let Marissa add technical export details. Once we confirm delivery preference we'll issue the manifest and chain-of-custody doc.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: admin_ledger_manifest_v2.csv (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Amira Khan <security@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated admin ops ledger export and delivery options for SOC2/SIG

Hi Amira / Logan —

Confirming details from the security side. Summary of what Redwood logs (and what we'll include in the snapshot):

- Authentication events: successful logins, failed logins, MFA events, session creations/terminations (timestamps + device agent string + source IP).
- Admin identity and context: internal user id, work email, org role at event time, associated team.
- Privileged operations: role/grant changes, policy edits, membership changes, API key/service account create/update/delete, OAuth client changes.
- Console & API calls: request ID, endpoint, request path, HTTP status, bytes in/out, latency, caller identity, and source IP.
- Model-serving administrative actions: model upload, deploy, rollback, variant creation, quantization change, model version pin/unpin. Each includes operator id, commit id (if applicable), and deployment target.
- Key management operations: KMS key create/rotate/destroy requests (metadata only; keys themselves not exported).
- Operator activity: container/host-level operator commands relevant to customer tenancy (when captured by our operator trail).*

Retention and fidelity:
- Default retention for admin activity ledger is 395 days (13 months) with full fidelity; we retain aggregated indices beyond that. We can provide the full 12-month window in native fidelity.
- Export formats supported: compressed Parquet (preferred for auditor ingestion), gzipped CSV, and newline-delimited JSON.
- Redaction/PII: email addresses for external users are hashed if requested; internal user identifiers are exported as internal IDs + job title. We can provide a redaction manifest if you require PII minimization.
- Sampling: we do not sample admin events for exports requested for audits — snapshots are exhaustive for the time window requested.

Delivery & chain-of-custody:
- Delivery options: (a) one-off encrypted tarball uploaded to a customer S3 bucket via cross-account temporary credentials, (b) Redwood-generated presigned S3 PUT link (valid 48 hours), (c) SFTP over FTPS with mutual TLS, or (d) Air-gapped handoff via encrypted drive (requires procurement coordination).
- Manifest & attestation: We will include a CSV manifest and a sha256 digest for every file, and a signed attestation (PKCS#7) from our compliance team. If you need a TSA timestamp on the manifest signature, we can add that (adds 1 business day).
- Provenance: snapshots include a custody.log with user ids who touched the snapshot, timestamps for generation/compression/signing, and transfer method recorded.

Operational notes:
- If you need near realtime ingestion we can enable a daily Parquet export + incremental deltas; hourly streaming is possible for Dedicated customers but not for hosted by default (we can enable as an enterprise option).
- For model invocation metadata: note that we log admin-level model operations; we do not include customer prompt-level content in admin snapshots. Invocation-level telemetry (non-content) is available separately via the request logs product if you have an instrumentation agreement.

Next steps: Logan/Vanessa to confirm delivery method and exact date range. We'll prepare the signed snapshot and provide the chain_of_custody_template.pdf and signed_manifest. Attached is a sample manifest and the transfer instructions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Controls Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachments: chain_of_custody_template.pdf (stub), signed_snapshot_transfer_instructions.txt (stub)

From: Amira Khan <security@stellarhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 14:37:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated admin ops ledger export and delivery options for SOC2/SIG

Marissa, Logan —

Appreciate the thorough breakdown. That covers what our auditors will want. A few follow-ups:

- TSA timestamping is preferred for the manifest; please include that and note the +1 business day in your timeline.
- We'll take the compressed Parquet snapshot and the SHA256 + PKCS#7 signed manifest. S3 presigned PUT (48h) is fine; please send the presigned link to security@stellarhealth.com and cc procurement (Ben).
- Can you include the custody.log in the top-level tarball so our auditors see the generation chain?
- For streaming/delta exports we'll leave that for a later conversation — the one-off snapshot is highest priority.

Requested timeline: can you deliver the snapshot by EOD next Wednesday (2027-11-24)? Our external auditor will start ingest on Thursday. If TSA adds a day, we need snapshot generation earlier to fit the window.

If you can confirm timeline and share the sample manifest (we received your manifest stub), we'll create the procurement ticket and share a DocuSign SOW referencing the transfer method.

Thanks —
Amira Khan
Sr. InfoSec Manager — StellarHealth
security@stellarhealth.com

--
Attachment: none
